audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Kled Levels 2, 3, First item and 2+ items and made Level 6 a Skill row — four rows against the packet chart and against this page's own whys text.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Kled. whys[1] and whys[2] both say your single-target Obliterate plus banked Indestructible out-trades his mounted skirmish; whys[5] says your first item makes the Q chunk lethal; whys[4] says Realm of Death is a clean 1v1 you win. The mirror already set row 4 to Mordekaiser, so leaving it as Skill here was a live cross-page contradiction.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs; rows 0, 3 (Skill) and 6 (Kled) already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] had bodies that did not match their own titles, and 'Chase his W remount' misstates how Kled remounts.
audit.why: Kit file: Bear Trap on a Rope is 800 range on 11/10/9/8/7s and only yanks if the shackle holds; Jousting is 550 range on 13/12/11/10/9s and recasts back through the target; Violent Tendencies is four fast attacks on 13/12/11/10/9s with the fourth hitting hardest; Kled's R is 140/125/110s. Skaarl is remounted by restoring Courage through fighting anything — it is the passive, not W. Dismounted Kled also deals less damage to champions, which is why R after the dismount is the whole win condition.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, report[9].t, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry real cooldowns, the Courage remount and the Violent Tendencies wind-up tell.

audit.why: Plated Steelcaps is right here — Kled's damage is physical and attack-speed-driven, unlike the Mercury's default on the rest of this champion's pages.

edits.before: Commit on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Liandry's Torment timing. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.

notes: Four chart rows were inverted against both the packet and this page's own whys text; fixed in matched pairs. The mirror's note that it rewrote its whys[1]/whys[2] 'to explain Kled winning those stages' reads as a possible disagreement about Levels 2-3; I followed the packet chart and this page's whys, which both give those rows to Mordekaiser.
